fdroid:de.baumann.browser.name: FOSS Browser
fdroid:de.baumann.browser.summary: A fully free (as in freedom) open source browser for Android.
fdroid:de.baumann.browser.description:
"FOSS Browser" is a fully free (as in freedom) open source Android browser: privacy-friendly with a modern user interface. - Your privacy - your data.
 Project Homepage with further info: https://codeberg.org/Gaukler_Faun/FOSS_Browser 
-------------------------------------------------
 UI/Handling 
-------------------------------------------------
FOSS Browser uses the latest Material You design libraries. Following system day/night mode and a wallpaper based theme are just two features of this new library. The UI is optimized for one-hand-use. All UI-elements are at the bottom of the screen.
More features:
• Keep screen on.
• Open links in background.
• Restore tabs on restart.
-------------------------------------------------
 Privacy 
-------------------------------------------------
FOSS Browser uses profiles to protect your privacy. For each profile you can enable or disable: AdBlock, JavaScript, cookies, fingerprint protection and much more. Profiles can also be saved for domains ("github.com" ⇒ Trusted website). This saved domains always overwrite the current profile. So, for example, "github.com" will always open with the trusted profile, even if you are browsing in the protected mode.
More privacy features:
• Build in AdBlock, which updates automatically. You can decide which content to block. AdBlock hosts are taken from Steven Black - AbBlock hosts: https://github.com/StevenBlack/hosts.
• Third-part-cookies can not be disabled.
• Enable or disable Android-autofill.
• Delete browser data (on app exit).
• Choose between different search engines (or set a custom one).
• FOSS Browser itself doesn't collect any data
-------------------------------------------------
 Bookmarks filter 
-------------------------------------------------
Organize your bookmarks with filters. You can set custom names for each filter. Long press the bookmark icon in the toolbar to get fast access to your favorite bookmarks.
-------------------------------------------------
 Gestures 
-------------------------------------------------
You can assign nearly twenty different gestures to the toolbar and the toolbar buttons. Each in four directions. You can also trigger events by long pressing the toolbar buttons. So you have up to ten different gestures to control FOSS Browser. Supported is for example: load last website, switch tab, reload, open bookmarks, ... and many more.
-------------------------------------------------
 Backups 
-------------------------------------------------
Backup all your important data (bookmarks, history, trusted websites and so on) on your SD-card. You can also back up FOSS Browser settings. Backups can even be restored on a fresh install or an other device (if you copy the backup files to the new device).

fdroid:io.github.cuso4deposit.regexcross.name: Regex Crossword
fdroid:io.github.cuso4deposit.regexcross.summary: Offline regex-crossword puzzles in hexagon and rectangle grids.
fdroid:io.github.cuso4deposit.regexcross.description:
Regex Crossword is an offline puzzle game. Every line of the grid is a regular
expression; fill the cells so that each line, read in its own direction,
matches its clue exactly (a whole-string match).
Features:
* Three difficulties: Easy (rectangle 5x5), Medium and Hard (hexagon). Puzzles
 are generated on your device from a seed, so the number of levels is
 unlimited.
* The hexagonal board has three colour-coded reading directions (X, Y, Z); the
 rectangle board uses rows and columns. Each clue shows its reading direction
 and start cell.
* Tap a cell and use the on-screen keyboard. Pencil-mark notes, per-cell hints,
 "givens" (letters a clue writes down literally), undo/redo, and a per-level
 timer.
* Progress is saved automatically for every level.
Hard levels are pre-generated with a solver so that their answer is unique.
No accounts. No ads. No network access. No permissions.
Regex Crossword is free software under the MIT licence. The hexagonal "A
Regular Crossword" form was popularised by Dan Gulotta (based on an idea by
Palmer Mebane) in MIT Mystery Hunt 2013. This app is an independent
implementation and includes neither the original puzzle nor its text.
Source code: https://github.com/CuSO4Deposit/regex-crossword

fdroid:io.github.yamin8000.dooz.description:
I created this implementation using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android devices.
 Features 
Technical

 Game 
 Variable game board grid size from three-by-three to nine-by-nine (Larger than nine-by-nine is simply ridiculous and unplayable in mobile phones)
 Variable game ai difficulty (easy, medium, hard)
Variations
Simple Game
The Simple game is the most simple variation of Tic-tac-tao with a three-by-three grid with two players. The player who succeeds in placing three of their marks in horizontal, vertical, or diagonal is the winner.
Simple Game AI
Currently, in hard mode, AI uses a strategy rather than an AI search algorithm like MinMax. This strategy consists of these steps: Win, Block, Fork, Block Fork, Center Play, Corner Play, and Side Play.
In Easy difficulty, AI plays a random empty cell in the grid. In Medium difficulty, AI chooses between Easy difficulty and Hard difficulty for each move based on a 50/50 chance.
 Strategy's source

fdroid:org.adaway.description:
A Free and Open Source ad blocker for Android.
The application is available for rooted and non-rooted devices.
Using rooted device, the application update your system hosts file that contains a list of mappings between host names and IP addresses.
Using non-rooted device, the application use the VPN feature to block outgoing connections to ads and trackers.
So when an app requests an ad or a tracker from a host in that file, this request is redirected to the local IP 127.0.0.1, which does nothing.
You can download predefined ads and blocker lists as hosts files from within the app to incorporate. It is also possible to use your own files and to add certain hosts to allowed and blocked lists.
There are options to run a local web server to respond to blocked host names and to direct requests to the IP address of your choosing instead.

fdroid:org.freemaps.datum.description:
A fully offline topographic, satellite and trail map for Android, built for the moment you lose signal and still need to know where you are.
Download a region before you leave and everything keeps working with no connection: the map, GPS position, waypoints, route planning and track recording. Satellite imagery, USGS topographic contours, trails, public land ownership, borders and street labels are all cached on the device rather than fetched on demand.
Features:
* Seven map layers that can be reordered, hidden, and given independent transparency, so contours can be read through imagery
* Public land ownership from the BLM Surface Management Agency dataset, showing BLM, Forest Service, state, tribal and private land
* USGS topographic contours labelled in feet, plus OpenTopoMap in metres
* Waypoints with thirteen icon types, undo and redo
* Route planning, either point by point or by connecting waypoints, with trimming and turn by turn navigation
* Track recording with live distance and elapsed time
* Sessions, so each trip's waypoints, routes and tracks stay separate
* Layer presets that can be saved and shared, containing settings only and no locations
Your data is written to a folder you choose as standard GPX files as you create them, so it opens in other outdoor applications with no export step, and nothing is locked in a proprietary format. Timestamps are left out of shared files by default, because a path shows where a trail goes while timestamps also show what hours you were out.
There is no account, no advertising, no analytics and no server.

fdroid:org.ojrandom.paiesque.description:
PAIesque is a privacy-first fitness tracker and live location sharer. Everything runs locally; sharing between users happens through your own server, not through Google, Strava, or any cloud provider.
 Record heart rate and GPS directly from BLE chest straps and other heart rate sensors. No companion app required. Multiple sensors can be recorded in parallel, and sessions are saved as GPX and CSV for use in other tools.
 Analyze your training on an interactive map and zoomable chart. View live metrics while a recording is active, or inspect past sessions by date range. The map track is colored by heart rate zone.
 Share live status and completed recordings with a group through a simple self-hosted PHP server. See other group members on the map in real time and browse their past sessions the same way you browse your own. Shared payloads are end-to-end encrypted; the server stores opaque blobs and cannot read them. If you don't have a heart rate sensor, the app also works as a pure GPS location sharer — no account, no third-party service, just your own server.
 Training-load metrics come from published formulas. Each formula in the app carries an evidence label so you know what is peer-reviewed, what is a professional convention, and what is a heuristic:
• TRIMP methods — Banister, iTRIMP, and LT-TRIMP.
• EWMA & ACWR — rolling load and injury-risk monitoring.
• Recovery metrics — RHR and HRV (RMSSD) from your sleep window.
• Polarized training — zone distribution and achievement tracking.
The app also includes a PAI-like score inspired by the Personal Activity Intelligence concept. It is not the official PAI algorithm — the official PAI is proprietary and commercially licensed by Mio Global. Values will differ from commercial implementations.
 Data sources. Heart rate can be recorded directly from BLE chest straps and other heart rate sensors, without any companion app. If your wearable needs a companion app to sync, Health Connect handles the import. Gadgetbridge is a natural companion for users of open-source wearables — it syncs heart rate from many devices into Health Connect, and PAIesque reads from there. Garmin Connect, Polar Flow, and other proprietary companion apps also work via Health Connect. No app-specific integration is required for any of them.
 Privacy is the default. No accounts, no cloud uploads, no analytics, no tracking. Data stays on your device; sharing happens only if you explicitly configure a server.

winget-run-community:IDRIX.VeraCrypt.name: VeraCrypt
winget-run-community:IDRIX.VeraCrypt.summary:
VeraCrypt is a software for establishing and maintaining an on-the-fly-encrypted volume (data storage device). On-the-fly encryption means that data is automatically
encrypted right before it is saved and decrypted right after it is loaded, without any user intervention. No data stored on an encrypted volume can be read (decrypted)
without using the correct password/keyfile(s) or correct encryption keys. Entire file system is encrypted (e.g., file names, folder names, contents of every file,
free space, meta data, etc). Files can be copied to and from a mounted VeraCrypt volume just like they are copied to/from any normal disk (for example, by simple
drag-and-drop operations). Files are automatically being decrypted on the fly (in memory/RAM) while they are being read or copied from an encrypted VeraCrypt volume.
Similarly, files that are being written or copied to the VeraCrypt volume are automatically being encrypted on the fly (right before they are written to the disk) in RAM.
Note that this does not mean that the whole file that is to be encrypted/decrypted must be stored in RAM before it can be encrypted/decrypted. There are no extra memory
(RAM) requirements for VeraCrypt.

flathub:io.github.quantum_mutnauq.fast_r.description:
Fast Reader helps you to read more quickly, by showing only one word after the other. Therefor
 the eyes don’t have to move from word to word, that reduce the speed of reading. To read the text
 you only have to copy the text into the big field in the middle and to start it. You can choose
 two different basic settings. Either you can choose the next word bei using the button „→“ or you
 can use the „Time based next word“. By this setting can be the duration of the word chosen. The
 selection is processed with a factor so that longer words are not displayed too short. This dynamic
 setting ensures that longer and more complex words are given more time to provide a natural and
 fluid reading experience. Reading can be started via the “Read” button. Experienced readers can
 even have more than one word displayed at once. This increases the reading speed even further.
 This program offers individual settings to improve reading:
 Background colour
 Font colour
 Font and size
 Reading progress in the text
 used to highlight which words took a particularly long time and which were read quickly.
 In the "Advanced settings for time-based next word", you can extend the display time for longer
 words. Here, you can set the duration of the time and from how many characters this time should
 be used. Additionally, you can also specify a delay at the start, so that the first word remains
 on the screen for a longer period.
 Customizable Settings: Tailor your reading experience by adjusting settings like background
 color, text color, font size, and display of progress indicators.
 Text Input: Easily input text into the application through a dedicated text entry field.
 Word-by-Word Display: The text is broken down into individual words, presented one at a time,
 facilitating focused reading.
 Navigation Options: Seamlessly navigate through the text using intuitive navigation buttons
 or convenient keyboard shortcuts.
 Progress Indicators: Keep track of your reading progress with helpful indicators displaying
 your current position in the text and overall progress.
 Time-Based Word predictions: You can set a variable time calculate by a formal for the display
 of each word. The formula for calculating the word display time is: "Time-Per-Word × (Cube Root
 of Word-Length)". This dynamic adjustment ensures that longer, more complex words are allotted
 more time, providing a natural and responsive reading experience.
 Statistic Collection: Generates statistics for you, showing how long you took to read each
 word.
 Colorize Statistics: Makes the statistics colorful (optional), allowing you to quickly see
 how long you took per word and identify which words were very slow or fast.

firefox-addons:2902339.name: Prod — Block Distractions & Boost Productivity
firefox-addons:2902339.description:
Prod is a simple, powerful productivity extension that helps you stay focused by blocking distracting websites and removing addictive elements (like YouTube recommended feeds). Whether you’re working, studying, or simply trying to avoid time‐sink rabbit holes, Prod lets you take control of your online experience.
Key Features
Hide Distractions
- Turn off recommended videos, comments, or Shorts on YouTube.
- Silence clutter.
Block Sites
- Instantly block major distractions like YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and adult sites.
- Add your own custom URLs to the block list.
- If you visit a blocked site, you’ll be redirected to a sleek “Blocked by Prod” page.
Greyscale Mode
- Transform the entire web into a calmer, colorless environment.
- Perfect for those who need fewer visual triggers when working or studying.
Minimalist UI
- A clean interface with toggle switches for each feature—no clutter, no confusion.
- Quickly turn Prod on/off or tweak settings right from the extension popup.
Timer
- Set a custom timer to keep yourself on task and lock certain settings until time’s up.
Why Prod?
- Stay Focused: By blocking out distracting elements, you can devote your attention to what really matters.
- Improve Productivity: Reduce the temptation to scroll, watch, or click endlessly.
- Easy to Use: No complicated setup—just toggle on the features you want.
- Free + Sponsors: We’re working with select sponsors to keep Prod free for everyone.
Privacy & Permissions
- Prod stores your block lists and settings locally in your browser—no personal data is sent to our servers (unless you choose to share it).
- We only request the permissions we need to hide or block content on specific sites.
Support & Feedback
- Homepage URL: prodextension.com 
- Support: support@focus.studio
- Join our community Discord for bug reports, feature requests, and general discussion.
How to Use
- Install Prod from the Chrome Web Store.
- Pin the extension in your browser toolbar for quick access.
- Open the Prod popup to enable/disable features like Hide Recommended, Block Sites, or Greyscale.
- Adjust your custom block list if you want to add more sites.
- Get back to your tasks with fewer distractions!
Updates & Roadmap
- We’ll be rolling out new features.
- Keep an eye on our Discord or Twitter for the latest announcements.
Disclaimer
- Prod is not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or Twitter.
- The blocking and hiding features are user-configurable and are provided “as is.”
- By installing, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
Install Prod now and start boosting your online productivity.

firefox-addons:858909.name: Web Design Pirate for DevTools
firefox-addons:858909.summary: Fast and easy way to copy web components, HTML widgets and parts of website design.
firefox-addons:858909.description:
Web Design Pirate is a Firefox DevTools extension that allows you to select an HTML node, and then gives you only the CSS styles that you need to render the full component (subtree).
Optionally, for copying wrapper-style components it also allows you to specify the level of inner HTML content that can be thrown away (to further reduce the number of needed CSS styles).
You will get a new tab called Pirate in your Chrome DevTools. If you inspect an HTML element on the page using the regular Elements tab, then switch over to the Pirate tab, that element will be automatically selected.

firefox-addons:676766.name: Fanfiction-tools
firefox-addons:676766.summary: This addon enhances the Fanfiction.net website in various ways
firefox-addons:676766.description:
It provides the following features, most of which can be turned on or off
 Autoloading of story chapters and lists
 Changing format of dates to UK/US e.g. published date
 Make story dates relative e.g. published date
 Combine reviews link and count
 Combine favorite count and follower count
 Mark word count in colour depending on word count per chapter 
 Mark story updated date in colour depending on when last updated
 Marking specified words in story summaries lists e.g. rape so you can avoid themif you wish
 Hide stories in lists if the summaries contains user specified words
Fixes the following elements:
 Dark theme
 Ability to select text so you don't lose your place
Added to control this please go to the Fanfiction Tools options menu (in the upper right section of the screen on the Fanfiction website)
For advanced filtering please see https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/fanfic-filter-quantum/ 
Please note when used with FanFic-Filter the "Indicates you are using the fanfic filter extension, and to disable filtering and list auto loading with fanfiction tools" should be used
Git hub repo for any issues is here: https://github.com/lesma/FanFiction-Tools

firefox-addons:982969.name: Nstools
firefox-addons:982969.description:
Extension pour le site Nstools
Analyser et tester rapidement les Dns, le Whois, les serveurs Web et Smtp d'un nom de domaine ou d'une adresse IP grâce à nstools.fr . Outil en ligne d'analyse la configuration technique d'un nom de domaine ou d'une adresse IP, effectue des tests nslookup sur les whois, DNS, MX, serveur web.
 NStools.fr est un outil gratuit permettant de vérifier simplement et rapidement la configuration d’un nom de domaine et de ses DNS. NS.tools effectue une analyse complète de l’arbre DNS depuis la racine, les Tld et les serveurs NS du domaine, afin de définir les serveurs DNS faisant autorité. L’outil testera aussi le paramétrage, la sécurité et la synchronisation des serveurs DNS. Des analyses sont également effectuées sur les whois, les MX, et le site web du domaine. Un audit complet et gratuit du domaine est réalisé afin de vous indiquer les erreurs de configuration ou les problèmes potentiels pouvant exister sur le paramétrage d’un domaine.

apple-macos:6788161762.name: European Portuguese Reference
apple-macos:6788161762.description:
Master European Portuguese with a pocket-sized reference and drill companion built for serious learners. Whether you're building fluency for life in Portugal or just love the language, European Portuguese Reference keeps the rules at your fingertips and the drills sharp. We built this app for ourselves because everything else out there seems to teach Brazillian Portuguese; but for those of us living in Portugal, that's not ideal!
Look up conjugation tables for any verb — present, preterite, imperfect, future, conditional, subjunctive, and imperative, plus the personal infinitive — generated on the fly from a complete rule engine that handles all three verb classes, stem changes, and irregular verbs. Browse gender and agreement rules, clitic pronoun placement, preposition contractions, and the constructs that trip up English speakers, all in one place. Contribute to curated vocabulary sections, review and learn with flash cards, learn pronunciation with built-in text-to-speech, and use a built-in dictionary to discover new words you want to learn.
Test yourself with multiple-choice grammar drills targeted to specific verb classes, agreement, and more. A dedicated vocabulary drill randomly asks you to translate Portuguese → English or English → Portuguese. The app tracks which questions you get wrong and prioritises them in future sessions. Your custom vocabulary words, flashcard ratings, and drill history sync automatically across all your Apple devices via iCloud.

apple-macos:6821727907.name: Tick List - Let's go shopping!
apple-macos:6821727907.description:
A shared tick list for the things you actually need: the shopping, the hardware run, what to pack. Built for the moment you are standing in an aisle with a basket in one hand.
SHOPPING MODE
Turn it on and everything already ticked drops out of sight, so what is in front of you is only what you still have to buy. Then tick things off as you go and they stay where they are — nothing disappears under your thumb because you brushed the screen. When you do want a clear-out, "Hide Checked" takes them away in one tap.
TAGS, NOTES AND PHOTOS
Colour-coded tags group the frozen things, or the dairy-free ones, and one tap filters the list down to just those. Add a note when the size matters, or a photo when the brand does — the label on the bottle, or where the part goes.
SHARED, PROPERLY
Share a list with whoever shops. Everyone sees the same list, ticks appear on everyone's phone, and nobody needs an account — it travels over iCloud to the people you choose, and you can stop sharing at any time.
ALSO
• Drag items into the order of the aisles
• Search as you type, and add straight from the search box when it is not there yet
• Remove duplicates in one go after a busy week
• The same lists on iPhone and iPad, and it works offline
HANDS-FREE, WHERE YOUR IPHONE SUPPORTS IT
Say "we need milk" and it goes onto the right list without opening or naming the app. This one needs iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence switched on, so it will not be available to everybody. Everything above works without it.
PRIVATE
Your lists are yours. They live in your own iCloud, we cannot read them, and nothing is collected, tracked or sold. There are no accounts, no adverts and no analytics.

apple-macos:1567803209.name: Grocy Mobile
apple-macos:1567803209.description:
This app is a companion for the Grocy application (https://grocy.info/). Grocy provides a self-hosted solution to pantry management and shopping lists.
The app allows you to access the server with a mobile-optimized interface on your iOS/iPadOS device and also login via Home Assistant Ingress. 
You need to host Grocy yourself, otherwise a reliable data storage is not possible (demo servers may get wiped sometimes).
There are no rented servers available in-app, you have to setup the server yourself.
This allows for a free distribution of this app, since the app has no infrastructure on its own.
Features:
 - native design, fully optimized for Liquid Glass
 - localization in many languages
 - full stock management, shopping lists, chores and master data management
 - a convenient Quick Scan mode, allowing for fast interactions
 - 100% free and open source
